description: This file provides helper methods for web page testing, specifically extracting tokens and IDs from HTML input strings.

classes.name: WebPageHelpers
classes.description: A static helper class that provides methods to extract verification tokens and IDs from HTML input strings during web tests.

methods.name: GetRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Extracts the request verification token value from an HTML input string using a regex pattern.

methods.name: GetId
methods.description: Extracts an item ID from an HTML input string based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: RegexSearch
methods.description: Performs a regex match on input string with provided pattern and returns the matched group value.
